about.titles: Software Engineer • Web, App & Software Developer • Islamic Scholar
about.body:
The depth of Islamic teaching and modern technology combine in my work to create effective digital solutions for real problems.

I design and develop modern websites, web applications, mobile apps and custom software for individuals, businesses, madrasas, schools, colleges, messes and other organizations. I also provide software upgrades, performance optimization and long-term technical support.

At the same time, I work on online Quran teaching, masala-based Islamic content, research-driven Islamic education and technology-enabled learning services.

My goal is one — to make technology simple, smart and secure for people’s benefit.
